_meta.purpose: PRE_BENCH_V2_FINAL_CLEANUP #5-#8: a price of 0/0 from a collector is ambiguous (real free tier, dedicated-only capacity, or a missing price). An override lets us record an EXPLICIT, dated, sourced classification for a specific (provider, model_id) pair instead of guessing from the raw 0/0 signal alone.

schema.provider: Provider label exactly as it appears in the row (e.g. 'Novita AI')
schema.model_id: Raw model_id exactly as returned by the collector
schema.pricing_status: 'free' or 'promotional_free' only — never used to fabricate a paid price
schema.verified_at: ISO date the classification was last checked against the provider's own docs/pricing page
schema.notes: Free text: why this is classified this way

entries.notes: Novita lists Ling-3.0-Flash-Fin at $0/$0 as a genuinely free specialized (finance) endpoint, not a missing price. FINAL_PRE_BENCH_V2_UX_ARCHITECTURE #3: model_id corrected to the collector's actual namespaced raw id (was missing the 'inclusionai/' prefix, so the override silently never matched).
